Title: Adaptive application controls - changing a VM group membership

Body.Content: Users can now move a VM from one group to another, and this way, the application control policy applied to it will change according to the settings of that group. Up to now, after a VM was configured within a specific group, it could not be reassigned. VMs can now also  be moved from a configured group to a non-configured group, which will result in removing any application control policy that was previously applied to the VM. For more information, see Adaptive application controls in Azure Security Center.
